subject: Acme MAP: Post-call recap & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Acme MAP: Post-call recap & next steps

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned on pain, goals, and next steps. Please reply with any corrections.

Pain points we heard
- Production latency spikes on peak traffic (tail p95 > 900ms) causing poor UX for search and chat features.
- Token-based costs are growing with current batching settings and inconsistent caching.
- Security/compliance requirement: SOC 2 + VPC isolation for customer data plane.

Goals (30/60/90-ish)
- 30d: Technical deep-dive + proof-of-concept scope agreed (integration points, sample dataset, success metrics).
- 60d: POC run on a 1–2 model workload demonstrating p95 < 250ms and cost delta analysis.
- 90d: Production rollout plan and commercial terms finalized.

Stakeholders
- Jane Doe — Product (decision influencer)
- Bob Carter — Procurement (contract owner)
- IT/security (TBD by Acme) — compliance sign-off
- Naomi Feldman (Redwood CS) — POC success and onboarding
- Rishi Malhotra (Redwood SE) — technical lead for POC

Proposed mutual action plan (attached draft):
- 11/30/2026: Technical deep-dive call with Rishi + Acme engineering
- 12/10/2026: POC kickoff (data access + sample traffic)
- 01/15/2027: POC completion & evaluation
- 01/31/2027: Commercial review and procurement

Attachments: Acme-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP milestones, owners, and success metrics)

Immediate asks
1) Confirm the decision criteria (performance & cost thresholds) and final procurement contact.
2) Confirm availability for the tech deep-dive week of 11/30.

I’ll update the MAP with any changes and send calendar invites once we confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Carter <bob.carter@acme.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: Post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks accurate. A few notes from our side: 

- Decision criteria: performance (p95 < 300ms for chat, p95 < 200ms for search), cost-per-query delta vs current infra, and security posture (SOC 2 + VPC). Those will be the high-level gates.
- Procurement contact for contracts is Bob Carter (cc’d). Bob — we’ll need procurement timelines; Acme typically needs 3–4 weeks for standard SaaS agreements after SOW.
- IT/Security: I’ll loop in our Head of Security, Lina Park, for the SOC 2 + network requirements. Expect intro this week.

We can do the technical deep-dive on Mon 11/30 at 2pm PT. Please loop in the SE. Also, can you send your SOC 2 summary and a short POC checklist for data requirements?

Great — thanks, Jane. Lina, welcome — copied Rishi (SE) and Naomi (CS).

We’ve booked Mon 11/30 at 2pm PT for the technical deep-dive. Agenda I’ll share in a follow-up calendar invite, but high level:
- Architecture review & integration points
- Performance baselines and measurement plan
- Data access & security checklist (minimal PII requirements)
- POC success criteria and timeline

Attaching a short SOC 2 summary and the MAP draft that includes owners and dates.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: Post-call recap & next steps

Hi all — quick note ahead of Monday’s call. Preliminary POC scope I recommend:
- Workload: Search (top priority) + small chat flow for UX spot-checks.
- Test dataset: ~50k sample queries (can start with anonymized logs).
- Success metrics: p95 latency, token cost per 1k queries, error rate, and qualitative UX notes.
- Infra: start on Redwood Dedicated trial capacity (2x A10G-equivalent slots) to mirror production concurrency.

Potential blockers: access to sample traffic (anonymized) and an IP allowlist for our test hosts. If Acme can provide those by 12/10 we’ll be able to start the POC that week.

I’ll bring an initial config and cost estimate to the meeting.

Cheers,
Rishi
